state: Dimensionless living vegetation fraction within existing source land cells, not carbon or biomass mass. Canonical class areas remain fixed; ecological state is a separate scenario.
law: Exact logistic growth substep followed by exact exponential mortality; growth depends on source temperature, soil-water fraction and inundated fraction; mortality on drought, inundation tolerance and temperature below-5C.
infiltration: Multiply dry-land and flood infiltration capacity by1+feedback*(vegetation-.5); no additional water sink. Existing evaporation and frost/recharge laws retained.
boundaryScope: All53803 non-lake terrestrial class interfaces, preserving10654 previous interiors; original ocean/lake mask boundaries remain fixed. Endpoints use exact canonical grid corners.
ecologyScope: 168576 hydrologically simulated source land cells; background land class geometry included but no invented background vegetation dynamics
limits: Authored boundary geometry, not observed forest edges
Vegetation fraction is not species composition or a carbon budget
